answer: If more than 3 wallets share one funding inlet within 24 hours, each pays a bond of 15 POA times its rank k in that group. N=1 costs 15 POA; N=100 costs 15*100*101/2 = 75,750 POA, and bonds cannot be pooled across wallets. Every wallet is a vertex in a public funding graph; 5 random validators audit 1 in 10 clusters and record findings in a sable log. An honest agent pays 15 POA once, refunded after 20 epochs. A wrongly flagged user appeals within 5 epochs for a full refund. It fails if a farmer funds wallets through many unrelated inlets.
